notes.title: United Assault - World War 2 Early Access Content overview
notes.content:
Soldiers,

United Assault - World War 2 is releasing in Early Access next week. Today we take a closer look at the content you can expect at launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213481/60afadb2d6ad07c68b712492dbf7577077edbd3e.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Maps and playable Factions at Early Access Start[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Pacific - Midway[/b] (playing as US Marines)
[*] [b]Eastern Fornt - Stalingrad[/b] (playing as Wehrmacht) - unlocked at Rank 10
[/list]
North Africa - Tobruk and Italy - Regusa will unlock over the duration of Early Access.

[h2][b]Maximum reachable rank[/b][/h2]
[b]37[/b] (450000 XP), this will increate to Rank 100 over the duration of Early Access.

[h2][b]Weapons in order of Unlock at Early Access Start[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Type 14
[*] M 1911
[*] Type 100
[*] BAR
[*] M1 Carbine
[*] Type 99
[*] Thompson
[*] M1 Garand
[*] Type 99 Sniper
[*] P38
[*] MP 40
[*] Mosin Nagant
[*] DP-28
[*] G 43
[*] Mosin Nagant Sniper
[*] PPSH 41
[*] SVT
[*] Volkssturmgewehr
[*] SVT Sniper
[*] PTRS-41
[/list]
Additional 25 Weapons will be added/unlocked over the duration of Early Access

[h2][b]Advanced Loot[/b][/h2]
Weapons can now be looted and exist in 5 degrees of rarity. Rarity is defined by the number of weapon modifications (in mechanic, there won't be visible attachements). Those modifications are randomly selected and can modify the damage, rate of fire, recoil and ammo capacity. A looted weapon can only be used in the session it was looted in.

If you dislike this variation of loot, you can simply distable it in the settings menu.
